The card — area rules

source: simplify-ask-card-ui-card.md

Area-wide

  • Who. The owner, answering the agents. On desktop in the chat or the Explorer, and sometimes on a phone.
  • Frame. One card, drawn at desktop width (about 560 px, the chat column) and phone width (360 px). The card has no route of its own. Every E surface hosts the same component.
  • Header row. Kind icon, ask id, title (one line while collapsed), PR badge when it has a PR, orphaned when its agent is archived, age. Tapping the header collapses or expands the card.
  • Order inside. Content first, then the answer bar, on every surface including the chat: body → links → PR line → preview chips → answer bar. You read the ask before you answer it.
  • Answer bar. Every way to answer sits together at the bottom of the card. First row: the agent's actions (wrapping as needed), with ⋯ at its right end. Directly below, the reply field at full card width. A reply is often a sentence or more, so the field never shares a row with buttons. It starts at one line and grows with its text up to about 6 lines, then scrolls. A card with no actions has no button row, and ⋯ sits at the right end of the reply field's row.
  • Feedback. Any answer disables the card's controls until the server confirms. The card then re-renders in its new state, and the reply field clears.
  • Errors. A failed answer shows the error in a toast, and the reply field keeps its text.
  • Permissions. None. Whoever has the app answers.
  • Labels. The ★ and the PR number never appear on live buttons: primary styling marks the recommended action, and the PR line carries the number.

Decisions (card, 2026-11-23)

  1. Content first; every way to answer sits in one answer bar at the bottom (owner review of the atlas).
  2. The reply field gets its own full-width row under the actions and grows with its text. Replies are often a sentence or more (owner review of the atlas, A7).
  3. Mark done lives in the ⋯ menu only; nothing sits next to ⋯ (A2).
  4. The ⋯ menu is the host's menu through a new plugin SDK Menu export (A1).

A1 Open ask

P110 states · 560 desktop · 360 phonecard text: simplify-ask-card-ui-card.md

Short

The ask waiting on you, with the agent's answers, a reply field and a ⋯ menu.

Extended

Shows the agent's actions, with the recommended one in primary style. A send action hands the instruction to the agent and moves the ask to A3. A resolve action records the choice and closes the ask as A4. An open action opens its URL and leaves the ask as it is. The reply field is one line and grows as you type. A send icon inside it appears once there is text. On web Enter sends and Shift+Enter adds a line; on phones Return adds a line and you tap send. ⋯ at the right end of the action row opens A2. Text in the reply field goes along with whichever action or menu item you press next.

Get here

Expand a row on any E view. In the chat, the card for the agent's latest call on an open ask is already expanded.

Shows

Header row. Body (markdown; in the chat behind a Details link when Settings → Plugins → Asks folds bodies). Links. PR line (PR #1265 open · checks ✓ · review required). Preview chips. The answer bar: agent actions and ⋯, then the full-width reply field "Reply to the agent…".

Scenarios

QA-approve and merge PR #1265 in one tap. Answer "fix the docs preview first" instead. Pick option b of a decision.

Variants

  • PR ask: checks passing, two preview chips, two actions.
  • Decision with four options, one recommended.
  • Question with no agent actions: the answer bar is the reply field with ⋯ beside it.
  • Reply field grown to several lines by a longer answer.
  • Decision with four options: the options wrap to two rows, with ⋯ ending the last row.
  • Reply field with text, send icon showing.
  • Phone width: actions wrap, with ⋯ ending the last row; the reply field spans the card below.
  • Orphaned: notice "The agent that raised this is archived. Closing it here notifies nobody."

Edge cases

  • Checks failing → the PR line shows checks ✗ in the error tone. The agent decides whether to keep its Merge when green action.
  • Has conflicts → the PR line adds has conflicts.
  • A preview deploying or failed → its chip shows ◌ deploying … or ✕ failed … and opens the logs.
  • The answer fails → toast "Could not send: …", and the reply text stays.
  • Answering an orphaned ask → toast "A3 closed; its agent is gone, so nobody was told."

A2 More menu

P1menu on A18 states · 560 desktop · 360 phonecard text: simplify-ask-card-ui-card.md

Short

The rare and closing moves, out of the way of the main one.

Extended

Items, in order:

  • Mark done: you did it yourself; closes the ask as done and tells the agent.
  • Discuss: opens a workspace where an agent explains this ask (a read-only side chat when the agent is not in a git repo); becomes Open discussion once one exists.
  • Open chat: goes to the agent that raised the ask.
  • A separator, then Drop ask in the destructive tone: closes the ask and tells the agent not to pursue it.
  • Text in the reply field goes along as the note; the labels don't change. Picking an item closes the menu. A popover on desktop, a bottom sheet on phones.

Get here

⋯ on A1, A3 or A4.

Shows

Up to four items with a separator before Drop ask.

Variants

  • Desktop popover, all four items.
  • In the raising agent's own chat: no Open chat.
  • Discussion already open: Open discussion.
  • Phone bottom sheet.
  • On A3 (in progress): Mark done, Discuss, Open chat, Drop ask.
  • On A4 (closed): Open chat, plus Open discussion while one is live. A closed ask starts no new discussion.

Edge cases

  • Orphaned ask → no Discuss. Mark done and Drop ask close it silently, and the toast says nobody was told.
  • Discuss on an agent whose provider has no read-only mode → toast "Side chats need a provider with a read-only mode (Claude)."

A3 Handed back

P14 states · 560 desktop · 360 phonecard text: simplify-ask-card-ui-card.md

Short

You answered; the agent is working on it.

Extended

No agent actions: the move is the agent's. Shows what you chose and when, in the form "You chose QA-approve + merge · 2 min ago". The answer bar keeps the reply field and ⋯, so you can add "actually, wait" or drop it. The ask returns to A1 when the agent gives it new actions, when its agent is archived, or after a day with the agent not running. In lists it sits under In progress.

Get here

A send action on A1. A reply alone leaves the ask waiting on you.

Shows

Header with the in progress badge. The outcome line. Body (collapsed by default outside the chat). PR line and chips, still live. Answer bar: reply field with ⋯ beside it.

Variants

  • Right after you chose a send action.
  • PR checks still running, chips deploying.
  • After a send action with a note, the note quoted in the outcome line.

Edge cases

  • The agent's turn ended without moving it → the agent gets one reminder. The card itself doesn't change.

A4 Closed ask

P16 states · 560 desktop · 360 phonecard text: simplify-ask-card-ui-card.md

Short

Done or dropped; kept as a record.

Extended

A collapsed row with the done or dropped badge in the muted tone. Expanded, it shows who closed it, how, and any note ("Dropped by you: superseded by #1270"), then the body read-only. The reply field stays: a reply reaches the agent, which may reopen the ask. ⋯ offers Discuss and Open chat only.

Get here

Mark done or Drop ask on A2, a resolve action on A1, or the agent resolving it.

Shows

Header with the status badge. Outcome line. Body. Links. PR line (merged/closed once the PR is). Answer bar: reply field with ⋯ beside it.

Variants

  • Done by the agent, PR merged.
  • Dropped by you, with a note.
  • Resolved by a decision option ("You chose b: squash-only").

Edge cases

  • The ask was deleted → the chat card header says "(since deleted)", and there is no body.

Where it sits — area rules

cards only · mockups pendingsource: simplify-ask-card-ui-hosts.md

Area-wide

  • Rule. No surface adds its own answer buttons. Everything you can do to an ask is on the card (A1) or its ⋯ menu (A2).

E1 Chat card

P1cards only · mockups pendingcard text: simplify-ask-card-ui-hosts.md

Short

The ask, inline in the agent's chat where it called ask_create, ask_update or ask_resolve.

Extended

The agent's latest call on an ask shows it live (A1–A4), with the answer bar below the content like every other surface; today's actions-above-the-body order goes. Earlier calls show a folded, read-only row "as that call left it". This change leaves those rows alone apart from the ★, which they keep because their chips have no primary style. Open chat is never offered here for the agent you are in.

Get here

Scroll the agent's chat.

Variants

Live open ask expanded; earlier version folded; body behind Details when the fold setting is on.

Mockups pending. This area is at stage 2: the card above is the agreed description. Stage 3 adds one frame per state here.
